import asyncio

async def act(page):
    # Select the Blue checkbox in the Create Product Configurations dialog to add blue color
    blue_checkbox = page.get_by_role("dialog", name="Create Product Configurations").get_by_role("checkbox", name="Blue")
    await blue_checkbox.check()
    # Click Next to proceed to the next step in the configuration wizard
    next_button = page.get_by_role("dialog", name="Create Product Configurations").get_by_role("button", name="Next")
    await next_button.click()
    # Wait for the dialog to update to the next step
    await asyncio.sleep(5)
    return "Selected Blue color and proceeded to next step"
